actions.name: Send email
actions.description: Sends an email using Postman

arguments.label: Recipient email(s)
arguments.description:
Enter the email addresses of the main recipients, separated by commas.
Each recipient will receive an individual email.

arguments.label: CC recipient email(s)
arguments.description:
Enter the email addresses to CC, separated by commas.
CC recipients will receive a copy of the email for each main recipient.
arguments.tooltipText: CC recipient status is not tracked. Blacklisted CC recipients will be ignored, but the email will still be sent to other recipients.

arguments.label: Sender name
arguments.description: For e.g., HR department.

arguments.label: Reply-To email
arguments.description: If left blank, this will default to your email address. Only one email address is allowed.

arguments.description:
Check supported file types [here](https://postman-v1.guides.gov.sg/email-api-guide/programmatic-email-api/send-email-api/attachments#list-of-supported-attachment-file-types).
Please note that the maximum file size for each file is 2MB, and the total size of all attachments cannot exceed 10MB.

setupMessage.messageBody:
There is a cap on total disk space and Excel actions across all Plumber users. To prevent disruption to your workflow, contact us if you have large files or need more than 100 Excel actions per hour.

Read [our guide](https://guide.plumber.gov.sg/user-guides/actions/m365-excel) for more information.
